measurement_note: Bob has no wall clock and invented timestamps in both runs (2025-07-15, ~60s), preserved verbatim in run-metadata.bob-raw.json. Every figure below is MEASURED externally: filesystem modification times of the artifacts Bob wrote, anchored to the screen recording's start time (encoded in its filename, 15:33:57). The recording began before the prompt was sent, so total_wall_clock_upper_bound OVERSTATES the run; it is an upper bound, not an estimate.

cross_run_consistency.note: Two independent runs both landed all four reviewer outputs within ~10s, which is the evidence for parallel rather than sequential execution.
